_comment: Measured results for the CWSD reproduction. Shape: {arm: {seed: {metric: value}}}. Arms and metric name match claims.json. Seeds match claims.json 'seeds'. Values are test-set accuracy on the clean 540-example stratified holdout, parsed from the single stdout line 'FINAL accuracy=<float>' of run_experiment.py at the paper's full configuration. 'BLOCKED' marks a value this environment cannot produce. Generated by run_all_arms.sh.
